sentence: This project plans future work on autonomous manufacturing by looking at equipment and workforce gaps across universities and industries.
This project expands a set of databases about plant metabolism to many more plant species and tests how certain enzymes work.
This project builds computer models to find out how cells move, divide and rebuild tissue when animals such as axolotls regrow limbs.
This project studies how to protect machine learning systems and data from cyberattacks using privacy-preserving methods.
This project finishes upgrades to a telescope instrument that takes infrared images of giant planets around young stars.
This project studies how robots can store energy in a spinning flywheel and use it to jump and move.
This project builds computer models that use monitoring data to predict how metal parts made by additive manufacturing hold up to corrosion fatigue.
This project brings researchers together to share findings on microplastics in freshwater and plan future work.
This project builds and compares computer models that spot cyberattacks on connected vehicles as they happen.
This project makes ultra-thin materials that control light based on its polarization and builds them into a camera.
This project develops paints and coatings made from a conductive polymer that reflect heat, and uses machine learning to guide the design.
This project builds artificial intelligence methods and computer hardware to study how genes and proteins interact in large biological networks.
This project tests whether synthetic turf can work as a top cover for landfills and how it handles moisture compared with other covers.
This project builds machine learning methods that engineers can understand and trust to model how structures move under dynamic loads.
This project develops ultrafast spectroscopic techniques to study how superconductors behave when driven by terahertz light.
This project builds wireless sensing systems that recognize human movement and activities, and tries to make them work in places they were not trained on.
This project tries to find out whether altermagnetism can exist in materials that are only a few atomic layers thick and how to control it.
This project tests whether satellite data and machine learning can help map where rare earth elements and other critical minerals are likely to be found.
This project studies how the immune responses of maize plants to root microbes differ between pure lines and hybrids and affect hybrid vigor.
